sources.summary: Wild's Collection – A Fold of Time Hidden in a Modern Shell - "A Perch" at Aranya Guangzhou Jiulong Lake — Aranya's first semi-open park commercial complex. The raw, site-cast concrete volumes are bold, modern, and open, exuding a quietly powerful restraint. And our task was to design a "street-side museum" within this context — Wild's Collection, a wilderness natural history discovery hub.
